bcherny.en:
Over the last few years, we have made significant progress on prompt injection for Claude models. As agents do more, it is increasingly urgent that we solve it across the industry. 

Really excited to partner with Gray Swan to host this competition. Can’t wait to see what you find!
bcherny.zh:
在过去的几年里，我们在 Claude 模型的快速注射方面取得了重大进展。随着代理商做得越来越多，我们在整个行业解决这个问题变得越来越紧迫。 

非常高兴能与灰天鹅合作主办这次比赛。迫不及待想看看你发现了什么！

levie.en:
They did it. They made a Muse open weights model, which is a huge step forward for OSS in the US. 

This is going to further accelerate AI diffusion because enterprises will be able to mix and match frontier performance for orchestration and high end tasks, while being able to have low cost and tailored post trained models for repeatable workflows. 

Overall this dramatically increases token consumption and workloads across the stack. Great to see Meta doing this.
levie.zh:
他们做到了。他们制作了 Muse 开放权重模型，这对于美国 OSS 来说是一个巨大的进步。 

这将进一步加速人工智能的扩散，因为企业将能够混合和匹配编排和高端任务的前沿性能，同时能够为可重复的工作流程提供低成本和定制的后训练模型。 

总体而言，这极大地增加了整个堆栈的令牌消耗和工作负载。很高兴看到 Meta 这样做。

danshipper.en: Of course that’s your contention. You just got finished reading about polysemanticity, so naturally you think interpretability means untangling superposition. You’re gonna believe that until next semester, when you find a neuron that lights up for the Eiffel Tower. Then you’re gonna spend the summer explaining how we can align a superintelligence because we know when it’s thinking about France. And next year you’ll realize that knowing it recognizes the Eiffel Tower doesn’t tell you what the fuck it’s planning.
danshipper.zh: 当然这是你的论点。您刚刚读完关于多语义性的内容，所以您自然会认为可解释性意味着解开叠加。你会相信这一点，直到下学期，当你发现一个为埃菲尔铁塔点亮的神经元时。然后你将花整个夏天的时间来解释我们如何调整超级智能，因为我们知道它什么时候会想到法国。明年你就会意识到，知道它识别出埃菲尔铁塔并不能告诉你它到底在计划什么。
